history.perspective: B25 - Font loading fallback and flash-of-unstyled-text
history.outcome: SEVERE GAP FOUND AND FIXED: no FOUT risk (single comprehensive fontMap), but useFonts' error was silently discarded, meaning any single bad font asset would freeze the app on the splash screen forever with no fallback (compounds with iteration 10's splash fix). Now proceeds past the gate on a font error instead of hanging. Live-verified the normal path has no regression; the error path itself not forceable to test live without corrupting a real asset.
